exposure: History of prior spontaneous preterm birth
cohort: 48 pregnant patients (16 with a history of preterm birth and 32 without a history of preterm birth) between 18 and 55 years of age at 11-16 weeks gestation
finding: Vaginal MMP-9 levels were significantly higher in pregnant patients with a history of preterm birth compared to those without a history of preterm birth.
birth_weight: 2,885 ± 898 g for the high-risk group and 3,480 ± 473 g for the low-risk group
